projects.name: LinWin
projects.summary: A C++20 and Qt 6 desktop-shell project designed to make Linux easier for people moving from Windows.
projects.analysis: The repository documents its beta releases, feature goals, and Linux compatibility work.

projects.name: Tux Steward
projects.summary: Native C++ and Qt system diagnostics, maintenance tools, and a lightweight process manager for Linux desktops.
projects.analysis: The repository documents beta installation packages and system utilities.

projects.name: iVivid
projects.summary: Linux video playback enhancements using mpv-related settings, shaders, and audio controls, targeting integrated graphics.
projects.analysis: The current README describes a Python/Tk-based launcher and playback configuration.

projects.name: Lumqenix AI
projects.summary: A locally runnable image and video enhancement prototype using conventional filters, scaling, and FFmpeg.
projects.analysis: The current public README explicitly distinguishes its prototype filters from learned AI upscaling.

projects.name: Animation Studio
projects.summary: An experimental open-source browser application for 3D modeling, sculpting, painting, and animation.
projects.analysis: The public README describes standalone web previews and Linux package builds.
